preconditions.description: The number of integers n is between 1 and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= a_i <= 9 for a_i in a)
preconditions.description: Each integer a_i is between 0 and 9.
The length of the string s is between 1 and 3.
The string s contains only the characters '-', '+', and '*'.
All characters in the string s are distinct.

postconditions.description: The output contains n numbers and n - 1 symbols.

postconditions.expression: all(symbol in s for symbol in output.split()[1::2])
postconditions.description: All symbols in the output are from the string s.

postconditions.expression: eval(output.replace(' ', '')) == max(eval(''.join(str(a_i) + symbol for a_i, symbol in zip(a, output.split()[1::2])) + str(a[-1])) for symbol in product(s, repeat=n-1))
postconditions.description: The evaluated expression is the maximum possible value.
